answers.why: The king gathers the elders of Judah alongside those of Jerusalem.
All the men of Judah accompany the king and Jerusalem's inhabitants.
Jeroboam made Israel sin through the high place at Bethel.
The man of God came from Judah, identifying his homeland.
Israel is the people governed by the judges.
The LORD's anger burns against Judah because of Manasseh's provocations.
The LORD will remove Judah and reject Jerusalem.
Israel is the nation already removed from the LORD's sight.
Foreign raiding bands are sent against Judah to destroy it.
Judgment comes upon Judah to remove its people from the LORD's sight.
Judah is paired with Jerusalem as the community cast from the LORD's presence.
Israel is named alongside Esau as a son of Isaac.
